name: contact-form-centered
title: Centered contact form
description: A narrow, centred contact form with a topic select, a message and a clear promise of when you will answer, for sites that need one simple way in.
docs: Pass title, description, topics (value, label and an optional second line), onSubmit (called with name, email, topic and message, trimmed; resolve to confirm, reject to show the error), promise and privacyHref. Mistakes are said in words next to the field, only once the reader has been in that field or has tried to send, and the first one takes focus. Sending disables the button but keeps its label. A failure keeps everything typed and hands focus back to the button. Success replaces the form with a status message that repeats the address it will answer and the promise, takes focus and is announced; Send another message starts again at the name field. messageLimit sets the counter, defaultValues pre-fills what you already know, and defaultStatus starts the form in the invalid, error or done state for a page that already knows it. Every fixed word and every error can be translated with labels.
